videos.title: Pure Class Heavy Attack Sorcerer Solo Build | ESO Update 51
videos.description:
Pure Class Heavy Attack Sorcerer Solo Build for ESO Update 51. It has access to a strong damage shield with Hardened Ward, gets constant damage shields from the Calculated Defense Class Mastery, and is very easy to play. It's on the lower end of DPS though.

This setup cleared Solo Moon Hunter Keep and Solo March of Sacrifices with 3 Misfortunes, and parses 56.1k DPS on the 6 million dummy.

Works for all kinds of solo content - overland at any Challenge Difficulty up to Vestige, World Bosses, Maelstrom Arena, Vateshran Hollows, early arcs in Infinite Archive, and Veteran Dungeon soloing.

Website guide - https://hyperioxes.com/eso/solo/heavy-attack-sorcerer-build
